strategies.title: The Typo Tactic
strategies.why: A user can submit a one-line typo fix to a popular repository to qualify for the 50% discount.

strategies.title: Self-Merging
strategies.why: A user can create a repository and merge a pull request into it to instantly qualify for the 20% discount.

strategies.title: Fork Manipulation
strategies.why: A user can merge a pull request into a fork of a project to satisfy the requirement for a merged PR.

strategies.title: The Blitz Account
strategies.why: A user can create a new account and immediately contribute to a high-star repo to grab the highest discount tier.
